description: Annotation schema for the real Sentinel-2 L2A Indian-domain optical chips. Every bounding box in this schema MUST correspond to a visually observable object in the actual satellite imagery. Pipeline-generated or heuristic annotations are NOT permitted.

YOLOv8n-Infra.normalization: all coordinates normalized to [0.0, 1.0] relative to chip dimensions (512x512)

Storage_Tank.visual_signature: Circular or cylindrical structures with bright reflectance from metallic roofs or shadow halos. At 10m GSD, tanks appear as small bright discs or circles. Large tanks may be 20-100m diameter (2-10 pixels). Look for tank farms with regularly spaced circular features.
Storage_Tank.positive_evidence_required: Clearly circular or elliptical shape, metallic roof reflectance or shadow halo, consistent with petrochemical/industrial storage context.
Storage_Tank.do_not_annotate: Any circular feature without industrial context. Do not annotate: agricultural water tanks, reservoirs, ponds, bus shelters, or circular road features.
Storage_Tank.uncertainty_handling: If uncertain whether a feature is a storage tank or water reservoir, mark class_confidence=UNCERTAIN and do not include in training set without human review.

Chimney_Stack.visual_signature: Narrow elongated vertical structure, often with shadow extending from a point source. At 10m GSD, chimney stacks appear as bright point or line features with directional shadows. May appear as a single bright pixel with an elongated shadow.
Chimney_Stack.positive_evidence_required: Visible shadow of appropriate aspect ratio and direction for a tall vertical structure. Industrial context (adjacent to process units or boiler houses).
Chimney_Stack.do_not_annotate: Transmission towers, masts, antenna structures, or any structure without confirmed industrial thermal purpose.
Chimney_Stack.uncertainty_handling: Mark UNCERTAIN if shadow length/direction is ambiguous.

Industrial_Shed.visual_signature: Large rectangular rooftop structure with flat or slightly gabled profile. At 10m, appears as a large bright or gray rectangle. Typical sizes: 50-300m length x 20-100m width. May have distinctive ridgeline shadows.
Industrial_Shed.positive_evidence_required: Rectangular footprint, industrial context (within industrial estate boundary), uniform roof surface texture.
Industrial_Shed.do_not_annotate: Commercial warehouses outside industrial zones, agricultural shed roofs, residential buildings.
Industrial_Shed.uncertainty_handling: Mark UNCERTAIN if the structure is at industrial zone boundary and land use is ambiguous.

YOLOv8n-Fire_Smoke.normalization: all coordinates normalized to [0.0, 1.0] relative to chip dimensions (512x512)

Flame_Front.visual_signature: In SWIR false color composite (B12-B11-B04): bright red/orange/white saturated pixels at the actual fire location. In true color (B04-B03-B02): may appear as dark char contrast area with possible glowing border. Typically narrow elongated zones at leading burn edge.
Flame_Front.positive_evidence_required: Bright SWIR B12 return (>0.5 reflectance) at the burn location. Confirm with B11. Active combustion requires high B12 return; char/ash residue alone does not qualify.
Flame_Front.do_not_annotate: Burn scars (past fires, no active B12 thermal anomaly), soil thermal emission, desert/bare-soil high B12 response without context of vegetation zone.
Flame_Front.uncertainty_handling: Mark UNCERTAIN if B12 is elevated but context is ambiguous (e.g., urban heat island, bare agricultural field). Do not force positive label.

Smoke_Plume.visual_signature: In true color: grayish-white opaque/translucent layer originating from a point source and extending downwind. The plume has a gradient from opaque near-source to translucent at edges. Distinguishable from clouds by: originating from a known fire location, irregular edges, brownish tint from aerosols.
Smoke_Plume.positive_evidence_required: Clear spatial continuity from a confirmed fire/burn area. Smoke plume direction consistent with VIIRS wind metadata. Plume reduces surface reflectance beneath it.
Smoke_Plume.do_not_annotate: Cirrus or cumulus cloud formations (well-defined edge, blue-white color, no ground source anchor). Fog banks. Industrial steam (unless co-located with fire evidence).
Smoke_Plume.uncertainty_handling: Mark UNCERTAIN if the plume origin cannot be confirmed. Haze blanketing an entire tile without a point source should NOT be annotated.

annotation_record_schema.scene_id: string — parent scene from acquisition plan
annotation_record_schema.annotation_id: string — unique UUID for each box
annotation_record_schema.reviewer_id: string or null — QC reviewer identifier
annotation_record_schema.review_decision: string or null — APPROVED | REVISED | REJECTED
annotation_record_schema.visual_evidence_notes: string — description of visible evidence in image
annotation_record_schema.tool_used: string — annotation tool name and version

what_is_not_permitted: Random box generation using numpy or any RNG
Coordinate-heuristic boxes based on known industrial GPS coordinates
Boxes derived from FIRMS thermal anomaly pixel locations
Model-predicted boxes without human review and confirmation
Copying box coordinates from synthetic/prototype DS_08 annotations
Annotating objects that are not visible in the optical chip
